## Column vapour and cloud repair (`limiter`) {#sec-ch10-fixvapor}

Local symbols: $\mathcal M$ is the window of $x_1$ cells one scan step rewrites. Tracked in ISSUES.md.

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What it does.** Removes negative vapour, and negative parentless cloud, along each $x_1$ column by mixing it with
the cells below at one common ratio to the dry density, conserving the column's mass.
**Switch.** EOS `limiter: true`; default false. The gather of a column split over $x_1$ blocks is on only for the
call from the stage update. **Fails.** A vapour column that cannot be repaired throws; a cloud column is clamped.
**Defining equation.** @eq-ch10-fixvapor-flatten.
:::

After the parent-vapour borrow (@sec-ch10-borrow) a cell can still hold negative vapour, and a condensate with no
nucleation parent cannot borrow at all. Both are repaired along the column: a negative cell is mixed with the
cells below it until the mixture is non-negative, and the mixture is spread at one ratio to the dry density. The
repair conserves the column's mass $\sum_i V_i\rho_{n,i}$, not its density sum, which matters on grids whose cell
volume changes with height. If nothing below can cover a deficit, the cells above supply it, bounded by the
deficit. A vapour column that cannot be repaired at all is an error; a cloud column in net deficit is clamped to
zero, which creates exactly the missing mass.

The repair is on with `limiter: true`. Aliases: the volume weights are #241, the upward branch #243, the
whole-column gather #244 and #268 ([chengcli/snapy#268](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/issues/268)); PR #230's
"the repair is per meshblock" is superseded by the gather.

### Derivation

Index the column from the bottom, $i=0..N-1$, with cell volumes $V_i$. The scan starts at the top. A cell with
$\rho_{n,i}\ge0$ is passed over. A negative cell starts a window $\mathcal M$ that grows downward one cell at a
time until $\sum_{l\in\mathcal M}V_l\rho_{n,l}\ge0$ or the bottom is passed. If the sum is non-negative, every
cell of the window is rewritten as

$$
\rho_{n,i} \leftarrow \rho_{\mathrm{d},i}\,\frac{\sum_{l\in\mathcal M}V_l\,\rho_{n,l}}{\sum_{l\in\mathcal M}V_l\,\rho_{\mathrm{d},l}}
$$ {#eq-ch10-fixvapor-flatten}

for $i\in\mathcal M$, and the scan resumes below the window. @eq-ch10-fixvapor-flatten is computed in
`fix_vapor_impl`: the window sums are `sum_vapor` and `sum_major` ([`fix_vapor_impl.h:32-39`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/fix_vapor_impl.h#L32-L39)),
and the common ratio `yfrac` is written to every cell of the window ([`fix_vapor_impl.h:66-70`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/fix_vapor_impl.h#L66-L70)).
The code weights by $V_l/V_0$, the volume relative to the column's bottom cell; the factor cancels in the ratio.

Multiplying @eq-ch10-fixvapor-flatten by $V_i$ and summing over the window gives back
$\sum_{l\in\mathcal M}V_l\rho_{n,l}$: the window's mass is unchanged, and every rewritten value has the sign of the
dry density, so it is non-negative. Windows are disjoint and the scan index only decreases, so the scan visits each
cell at most twice and terminates. If the bottom is passed with the sum still negative, the deficit
$D=-\sum_{l\le i_0}V_l\rho_{n,l}/V_0$ of the cells from the starting cell $i_0$ down is taken from the cells above,
in order, each giving at most what it holds; the cells from $i_0$ down are set to zero. Before writing anything this
branch checks that the cells above hold at least $D$, so it writes nothing when it fails
([`fix_vapor_impl.h:41-64`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/fix_vapor_impl.h#L41-L64), `deficit`).
A window repaired earlier in the same scan stays rewritten, though: a column that fails below an already repaired
window is returned with that window flattened, mass kept. The kernel fails on a non-positive dry density; otherwise, in every case
`fixvapor_check.py` tried, only on a column whose total vapour mass is negative.

::: {.callout-important title="Check"}
All of this is checked by `src/snapy_report/ch10/fixvapor_check.py`, a line-for-line port of the kernel. It replays
the inputs of the `eos_limiter` gtests (`[C1]` to `[C3]`), keeps $\sum_iV_i\rho_{n,i}$ to $2.2\times10^{-15}$ relative
on 1995 repaired random columns with unequal volumes (`[C4]`), finds no failure on a column with non-negative total
(`[C5]`), repairs an interior and a bottom deficit in one scan (`[C6]`) and confirms the partial rewrite before a
failure (`[C7]`) [sha: the formulas of snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0, ported line for line; deck:
the check itself; run: `python3 fixvapor_check.py`, numpy, double]. The partial rewrite is a property of the port; it
has not been reproduced in a snapy run.
:::

### Numerical method

The kernel runs once per $x_1$ column of interior cells, one CPU thread or one CUDA thread per column, inside each
call of the conserved limiter. Parentless clouds are repaired first without requiring success and then clamped;
vapour is repaired second and must succeed
([`equation_of_state.cpp:307-312`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L307-L312), `parentless`).
When the call comes from the stage update and $x_1$ is split over several blocks (`pz` > 1), every block gathers
the full column with the dry density and the volumes, repairs it and keeps its own slice
([`equation_of_state.cpp:276-305`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L276-L305)).
Failures are counted with `std::atomic` on CPU and `atomicAdd` on CUDA, and read back once per call, which costs one
device synchronisation. @fig-ch10-fixvapor-column shows a column with an interior and a bottom deficit.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch10-fixvapor-column
#| fig-cap: "One 64-cell column before and after the repair, as the ratio of vapour to dry density. The vermillion dashed line with crosses is the column before, with a negative cell at index 40 and one at the bottom; the green line with dots is after: cells 40 and 39 share one ratio, and the bottom deficit is taken from cell 1 above it. The column's mass is unchanged."
#| fig-alt: "Vertical profile of vapour ratio against cell index; two negative excursions before, none after."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch10.fig_fixvapor_column import make_fig
make_fig()
```

: Code map of the column vapour and cloud repair. {#tbl-ch10-fixvapor-code}

1. Take the cell volumes so the repair conserves mass ([`equation_of_state.cpp:272-273`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L272-L273), `vol`).
2. Gather the column when split over $x_1$ blocks ([`equation_of_state.cpp:280-288`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L280-L288), `gather_x1`).
3. Run the kernel per column ([`equation_of_state.cpp:289-296`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L289-L296), `call_fix_vapor`).
4. Throw for vapour ([`equation_of_state.cpp:297-299`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L297-L299), `require_success`).
5. Copy back this block's slice ([`equation_of_state.cpp:300-304`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L300-L304), `copy_`).
6. Mark the limiter only above round-off ([`equation_of_state.cpp:313-321`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp#L313-L321), `positivity_roundoff`).

A user can hit one message: "[EquationOfState] apply_conserved_limiter_: Failed to fix vapor mass fractions."

The `eos_limiter` cases are the inputs replayed by `fixvapor_check.py`; the bottom-cell case asserts the transfer
itself to $10^{-25}$ absolute, because a tolerance on the supplier's value would also pass a supplier that gave
nothing ([`test_eos.cpp:68-89`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/test_eos.cpp#L68-L89), `repairs_bottom_cell_from_above`).
`test_fix_vapor_volume` keeps the column mass of a spherical-polar column to $10^{-12}$ in float64 and $10^{-6}$ in
float32 ([`test_fix_vapor_volume.cpp:82-84`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/test_fix_vapor_volume.cpp#L82-L84), `tol`).
The split-column test requires every vapour cell of a two-block column to equal the one-block result exactly
([`test_vapor_column_nb1.cpp:133-143`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/test_vapor_column_nb1.cpp#L133-L143), `vapor_repair_keeps_the_mass_with_nb1_2`).
Also registered: `test_parentless_cloud_nb1.release`, the 2-rank `test_parentless_cloud_nb1_mp` (rain and total
mass to $10^{-12}$), `test_fix_vapor_counts_every_column_python` (one broken column in 16384 is reported) and the CUDA
arm `test_fix_vapor_reports_failure_cuda_python`. Measured results at the pin are **missing evidence**
(the verification catalogue's entry for this chapter).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
A vapour column whose total is negative stops the run. A cloud column whose total is negative is clamped, creating
the missing mass.
:::

- The downward branch mixes: it moves vapour beyond the deficit, over the whole window.
- A failure below an already repaired window leaves that window rewritten (`fixvapor_check.py` `[C7]`, port only).
  For vapour the run stops anyway; for parentless clouds the rewrite stays, mass kept.
- Serial callers with several $x_1$ blocks wait at the gather (PR #244); the cross-process gather has not run on CUDA.
- The weight is relative to the bottom cell, so last-bit differences in spacing can move results at round-off
  (PR #243).
- Not in the switch coverage matrix (@sec-ch12-matrix).
